resources.string: Good day. %1$s at your service. How may I help?
Enter sends · Shift+Enter new line · hold Space to talk · Menu settings
Choose where my answers come from in Settings.
Free. Nothing leaves your home network.
LM Studio, llama.cpp or any server with an OpenAI-style API.
Free plan with your own key. Your messages go to %1$s; free plans have limits and may use messages for training.
Your computer\'s address. Ollama must listen on the network: set OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0 and restart it.
Paste the key from the provider\'s website
No model chosen. Test the connection to list them.
Connected. %1$s models found; choose one below.
Connected, but the server lists no models.
Choose where my answers come from first.
Enter your server\'s address, for example 192.168.1.20.
Plain http only works on your own network. Use an https address.
Choose a model in Settings first.
I couldn\'t reach the server. Check the address and that it is running.
The server took too long to answer.
Conversations stay in memory only and are gone when you start a new one.
Listening… let go when you\'re done.
Hold Space in an empty message box, or hold Talk, and speak (English for now). Speech becomes text on this phone and waits for you to send it. Nothing listens unless you hold.
To talk, download the speech model in Settings.
The speech model couldn\'t be downloaded.
Allow the microphone so I can hear you while you hold.
I\'ve prepared a text to %1$s. Check it below and send it if it\'s right.
I couldn\'t send it from here, so it\'s waiting in Messages for you to send.
I couldn\'t find %1$s in your contacts. Try their number, or the name as it\'s saved.
Allow contacts so I can find who to text.
Allow sending texts so I can send it for you.
